scientific_integrity: All-exponent proof supplied; finite checks are corroborative, not a substitute for universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Only n=2^a p^b with a,b>=1 and p an odd prime; does not solve the unrestricted Erdős–Nicolas classification; historical priority remains subject to unindexed literature.
title: Complete two-prime-support classification of Erdős–Nicolas initial-divisor sums
